source.author: stat
source.text: non haec incassum divisque absentibus acta; forsan et has venturus amor praemiserit iras, ut meminisse iuvet.
source.text_original: non haec incassum divisque absentibus acta; / forsan et has venturus amor praemiserit iras, / ut meminisse iuvet.
source.text_english: These things were not done in vain or before absent gods; perhaps love, when it comes, has even sent these angers ahead, so that it may be pleasant to remember them.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ite, viri, mecum dubiisque evincite rebus, quae meminisse iuvet nostrisque nepotibus instent.
reuse.text_original: ite, viri, mecum dubiisque evincite rebus, / quae meminisse iuvet nostrisque nepotibus instent.
reuse.text_english: Go, men, with me, and overcome the doubtful circumstances, that it may be a pleasure to remember them and they may press upon our grandsons.
